name: @papercupai/orchestrator-spawn
description: Phase 9 spawn primitive — lets agents launch other agents as a tool call. spawn → poll → cancel; tracks parent_spawn_id lineage in tool_invocations for the Intel panel's spawn-tree view.

tools.name: spawn
tools.description: Launch a child agent of the given role with feature/chunk/run context inherited from the caller. Returns immediately with a spawnId; use orchestrator.poll to check status. Allowlist-gated: architect can spawn worker/validator/scoper/reviewer/debugger; operator can spawn anyone; debugger→validator; scoper→validator/reviewer; reviewer→architect; worker/validator/documenter/curator cannot spawn. Caps: depth ≤ 3, ≤ 5 children per parent, ≤ 10 concurrent total.

featureId.description: Optional feature ID for the child's spawn context.

chunkId.description: Optional chunk ID. Required when role='worker'.

extras.description: Extra ENV=val args to pass to the child agent process.

guidance.when: Operator delegating work to another agent (worker for a chunk, validator for a plan check, scoper to break down a feature, reviewer to look at a diff). For OPERATOR specifically: prefer the `<spawn role="..." />` tag in your turn output — it routes through the same dispatch and you don't need an MCP roundtrip. The tool form is for non-operator roles.
guidance.notWhen: For asking the user a question, use `chat:ask_choice`. For tracking intent without execution, use `tasks:create`. spawn = execute, not plan.
guidance.chaining: Returns a spawnId immediately. Use `orchestrator.poll` to check status; `orchestrator.cancel` to stop a running spawn.

tools.name: poll
tools.description: Read the current state of a spawn launched via orchestrator.spawn. Returns { spawnId, status, role, startedAtMs, finishedAtMs?, lastInvocation?, error?, exitCode?, durationMs? }. status is one of running|done|failed|cancelled.

guidance.when: Check the status of a spawn you launched. Returns running/done/failed/cancelled + exit code + duration.
guidance.notWhen: For listing ALL active spawns you started, use `orchestrator.list_active`. Don't poll in a tight loop — spawns take seconds to minutes; once a turn is plenty.

tools.name: list_active
tools.description: List spawns the caller initiated that are currently running. Pass scope='all' to also include this host's other-parent spawns; default scope='mine' filters to spawns whose parentSpawnId matches the caller's ctx.spawnId.

guidance.when: User asks "what agents are running?", "what did I spawn?", or you need to enumerate in-flight delegates before deciding whether to spawn more (concurrency cap is 10).
guidance.notWhen: For a single spawn's status, use `orchestrator.poll` with the spawnId.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Send SIGTERM to a running spawn (then SIGKILL after 2s). Same allowlist gating as spawn — if you can spawn the role, you can cancel a running instance of it. No-op for non-running spawns; returns the post-cancel state.

guidance.when: User asks to stop a running spawn ("kill the worker", "abort that scoper"). Sends SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 2s.
guidance.notWhen: For done/failed spawns, this is a no-op — just call `orchestrator.poll` to confirm state.
